sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt: USE OF PROCEEDS Any sales of Pubco Class A Common Stock by the Holder pursuant to this prospectus will be solely for the Holder’s account. We will not receive any proceeds from any such sales. However, assuming sales of the full 5,218,935 shares are made at the closing stock price on the cover of this prospectus, we may receive up to approximately $80.7 million in aggregate gross proceeds from the Holder under the Purchase Agreement in connection with sales of Pubco Class A Common Stock to the Holder pursuant to the Purchase Agreement after the date of this prospectus. We estimate that, assuming sales of the full 5,218,935 shares are made at the closing stock price on the cover of this prospectus, the net proceeds to us from the sale of Pubco Class A Common Stock to Cantor pursuant to the Purchase Agreement will be up to $78.3 million over an approximately 14-month period, after estimate

sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt: Dividend Policy We have not declared or paid any dividends on the Pubco Class A Common Stock to date. We anticipate that we will retain all of our future earnings, if any, for use in the operation and expansion of our business and do not anticipate paying cash dividends in the foreseeable future. Any decision to declare and pay dividends in the future will be made at the sole discretion of the Pubco Board and will depend on, among other things, our results of operations, cash requirements, financial condition, contractual restrictions, including restrictions under the Convertible Notes, and other factors that the Pubco Board may deem relevant. 75 UNAUDITED PRO FORMA CONDENSED COMBINED FINANCIAL INFORMATION Introduction The following unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial statements present the combination of financial information of Pubco, SPAC and the Company, adjusted to give
